reason: The README describes a local plugin discovery and recipe guide that matches natural-language requirements to curated entries, explains results, and generates ordered installation commands without executing them.

summaries.zh: 根据自然语言需求从精选插件目录中匹配合适的插件，并提供匹配理由、安装命令和预设安装方案。
summaries.en: Matches natural-language needs to curated plugins and provides match reasons, installation commands, and predefined installation recipes.

capabilities: local semantic matching of natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory
display of plugin descriptions, match reasons, and installation commands
listing and searching predefined installation recipes
generation of ordered installation plans without executing commands
